name: smwpatches-podoboo-buoyancy-fix
title: Podoboo Buoyancy Fix
description:
This patch fixes the bug where the game will get stuck in an infinite loop if a Podoboo is placed in a level without buoyancy enabled. Additionally, it implements a system that allows the Podoboo to jump out of non-liquid tiles (and liquid with buoyancy disabled).
Useful if you want to have Podoboos in your level without the increased risk of buoyancy-induced lag. Buoyancy still works as normal.

For ease of use, disable Lunar Magic's "Vertical Fireball Buoyancy" check in General Options after applying this patch.

See the asm file for a few additional options.
